62

SUMMARY SHEET ON THE 1918 FEB 13 EARTHQUAKE (SHEET 3 OF 3)

Heyuan - Falling of tiles
- Damage to some old walls
Heping - Strong vibrations
Chaozhou 14:00 - Many houses damaged and collapsed

(total collapse 20%)
(partial collapse 40%)
(slight damage 80%)
- Conspicuous cracks in the ground

Fengliang - Many people killed
- 2 to 3% of houses collapsed
- Many houses damaged

Chaoyang - Many houses damaged and collapsed
- Conspicuous cracks in the ground
Jieyang - 90% houses damaged
- 50% houses collapsed
Raoping - Over 100 people killed
- Numerous people injured
Huilai - Some houses collapsed
- No injury
Dabu 14:00 - Many houses collapsed
- Cracks in walls
Puning - Many houses collapsed
Nanao - Nearly all houses collapsed

- Many people killed and injured

Meixian - Many houses collapsed
- Cracks in many walls

Xingning - Many houses collapsed

Jiaoling - Caving in on flat ground; water
flowed out
